owen.t: I can do dedupe fingerprinting. Will avoid removing tenant_id. Plan: PR + staging test.

yasmin.k: I'll handle latency thresholds/backtest. I will run 45-day histograms and propose new values.

frank.l: I'll own paging policy docs and pilot rollout. Suggest 7-day pilot on svc-beta with rollback steps.

ops-bot: Task created TASK-2026-8100, linked to postmortem.

rachel.m: Please post one-line acceptance criteria + deadline (close next Tue).

owen.t: Acceptance: staging shows >=70% reduction in pages for rule WorkerError in 48h. Deadline: 2026-04-06.

yasmin.k: Acceptance: false positives <=5% on backtest; no missed critical incidents. Deadline: 2026-04-05.

frank.l: Acceptance: paging policy updated, pilot runs 7 days, pilot owner signs off. Deadline: 2026-04-04.

rachel.m: Thanks. I'll create the follow-up issue and schedule a 10m check-in Mon 10:00. Post PRs here when ready.
